thread:
zoe: Quick thought 1-week beta sprint to prioritize top customer asks. Keep cohort small (5 teams) and outcome-focused: clear feature asks + one actionable roadmap change.

ravi: 5 sounds good. What's the intake look like?

zoe: Short form: 1) 2 use-case bullets, 2) environment (hosted/dedicated/private), 3) expected traffic, 4) willingness to run simple evals + 30m exit interview.

clare: Incentives? credits + public case study offer? low overhead wins.

zoe: credits + sync with product lead. Also promise a short prioritization report that shows where partner demand sits.

ravi: operationally we need tagging in telemetry: beta_id, partner_id, sample_session. I'll add a one-line schema and webhook.

clare: feedback loops: one weekly micro-survey (2 fields), in-app thumbs, end interview. Keep it lightweight.

zoe: success gates proposal:
- Recruitment: fill cohort within 10 days
- Signals: identify >=3 recurring asks across partners
- Engagement: >=60% complete end interview
- Risk: any partner needing private infra gets escalated and gated

ops-bot: Note scheduled: beta-invite Sent by @ravi 2025-10-21T17:00:00Z

ravi: I'll draft invite + Airtable intake today and tag owners. clare: can you prepare one vertical eval pack by Thu?

clare: on it. will keep scoring simple (pass/fail + short comment).

zoe: Great. Check back here EOD Friday with updates.
